scale: Each criterion score is an integer from 0 through that criterion's weight; total is the sum out of 100.
assumptions: Personal/local research scale; no multi-tenant search requirement.
Originals and neutral metadata must survive replacement of any UI application.
AI and embeddings are optional and cannot be source truth.
Existing operational IPOS DuckDB and knowledge files remain separate.
Scores are research judgments, not production benchmarks.

options.name: Karakeep-centric evidence library
options.rationale: Strong capture/search/API and local deployment; weaker neutral content identity, structured financial metadata and app-independent export.

options.name: Zotero-centric evidence library
options.rationale: Excellent scholarly metadata/citations and mature translators; narrower general-document/data/web-version coverage and official export limitations.

options.name: Karakeep plus Zotero
options.rationale: Broadest mature UI combination, but two canonical libraries create identity, synchronization, backup and search maintenance costs.

options.name: Filesystem/Markdown plus deterministic search
options.rationale: Best neutral preservation and determinism with simple FTS, but lacks a polished capture/review workflow and needs small glue.

options.name: Hybrid evidence store plus local search index
options.rationale: Neutral immutable truth plus replaceable Karakeep/Zotero views, local FTS and routed parsers maximizes evidence qualities; boundary glue and integration tests remain.

sensitivity: E leads D by 5. If capture integration is not adopted, E degrades safely to D because the canonical object/manifest contract is unchanged.
